text:
sam: hey team, first-day hiccup. VPN (WireGuard newhire-prod) shows connected but `docker pull internal.registry.redwood.internal:5000/my-app:latest` just sits and then times out. browser to https://intranet.redwood.internal works fine though. anyone hit this? :thinking:

it-ops: hmm weird that intranet loads but docker can't pull. quick checks: what does `dig registry.internal.redwood.internal @10.10.0.53 +short` return? also `ps aux | grep -i warp` or `brew services list` — did you have Cloudflare WARP/WARP+ installed previously?

sam: `dig` returns the internal IP `10.10.3.7`. `ps` shows `/Applications/Cloudflare WARP.app/Contents/MacOS/warp-svc`. I totally forgot I installed WARP for personal use.

morgan: ah that explains it. WARP (the Cloudflare client) can capture DNS/traffic and send it out-of-band, breaking split-tunnel for some apps like Docker Desktop which uses the host resolver differently. Two quick options:
1) Temporary: in Docker Desktop prefs -> Resources -> Network -> set DNS to `10.10.0.53` and restart Docker. That should let pulls hit internal registry.
2) Better: disable/uninstall WARP while using Redwood VPN, or set WARP to allow local network access if using Teams config. To turn off fast for testing: open the WARP app and toggle "Disconnect". Or from CLI:```
/Applications/Cloudflare\ WARP.app/Contents/MacOS/warp-cli disconnect
/Applications/Cloudflare\ WARP.app/Contents/MacOS/warp-cli disable
```
(If warp-cli isn't present, just quit the app from the menu bar.)

sam: tried toggling WARP off, then restarted Docker and `docker pull` succeeded immediately. :tada:

it-ops: great. we'll add a note to onboarding: check for consumer VPNs/WARP and Docker Desktop DNS override. Morgan, can you add the Docker DNS step to the docs and a short note about consumer VPN interference?

morgan: yup will do. Also adding a one-liner for CLI folks who want a temporary docker fix:```docker pull --dns 10.10.0.53 internal.registry.redwood.internal:5000/my-app:latest```

devex-bot: created ticket #INFR-3621 to add WARP/consumer-vpn troubleshooting and Docker DNS quickfix to the new-hire checklist and onboarding docs.

sam: thanks all — saved my afternoon. if anyone on the team wants the command I used to check WARP processes, here it is:```ps aux | grep -i warp || true```

morgan: adding a note in the ticket to include detection snippet for Mac/Windows so the infra onboarding flow can prompt a warning on sign-up. :+1:
